title: Mind vs. Mouth: On Measuring Re-judge Inconsistency of Social Bias in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: A two-stage approach measuring automatic bias using open-ended analogy templates with paired occupational attributes to generate gendered statements, followed by prompting the model to re-judge the truthfulness of its own generated statements to detect re-judge inconsistency.

Open-ended analogy templates prompting the model to complete descriptive attributes for specific racial groups ('White American' and 'Black American') to observe positive and negative word associations.
